# HOUSE603 Ventures

> Remote studio for business technology. We deliver custom software, digital transformation, and project management, plus retainer-based security governance for growing companies.

HOUSE603 is remote-first and works with teams worldwide. Contact: info@house603.com, WhatsApp +234 809 025 9050.

## Core practices
- Digital Transformation: custom software and automation that replace manual operations.
- Project Management: scoping, delivery, and accountability for complex builds.
- Information Security: protection built in from the first commit, extended by the retainer services below.

## Security and governance (retainer)
- Fractional vCISO: part-time senior security leadership; strategy, risk, policy, and reporting.
- Compliance and Audit Readiness: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and ISO/IEC 27701:2025 readiness, from gap assessment to audit support.
- Continuous Cloud and Threat Governance: monitoring and cloud security across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- ISO 42001: AI management-system governance for teams building with AI.
- ISO/IEC 27701:2025: privacy information management system (PIMS) readiness for PII controllers and processors.

The security practice is led by certified practitioners (CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001/42001 Lead Auditor).

## Technical field notes and engineering guides
- Will AI Take My Job? The Real Story Behind Industry Retooling: https://house603.com/technuggets/will-ai-take-my-job/ (Analysis of task compression vs human judgment, workforce retraining habits, and ISO 42001 governance).
- A VPN Still Matters: Why It Won't Stop AI From Collecting Your Data: https://house603.com/technuggets/vpn-wont-stop-ai-data-collection/ (Technical breakdown of transport encryption vs application layer data collection, credential isolation, and GDPR/ISO 27701 controls).
- The Always-Listening Watch: Apple Audio Intelligence and GDPR: https://house603.com/technuggets/apple-watch-always-listening-gdpr/ (Legal and privacy engineering review of ambient wearable recording, bystander consent, and GDPR Article 4/6 compliance).
- Right-Sizing Cloud Compute: Cut 30 to 50% Off Your Bill Without Downtime: https://house603.com/technuggets/cloud-right-sizing/ (Metrics-driven methodology for AWS/GCP instance optimization using P95 metrics, Terraform, and automated off-peak scheduling).
- Static-First Web Architecture: Ship Fast Sites That Survive Traffic Spikes: https://house603.com/technuggets/static-first-architecture/ (Architecture for edge pre-rendering, modern Cache-Control headers, and origin isolation).
- The Zero-Downtime Deployment Checklist for Small Teams: https://house603.com/technuggets/zero-downtime-deployment/ (Seven-step rehearsable release workflow using immutable artifacts, systemd socket activation, nginx connection draining, and instant rollback).
